_doc: Hand decisions for cells where no two sources agree, or where the agreed form must change. Key: verb/tense/person (one cell) or verb/tense (six cells, null for imperative yo; one string for gerundio/participio). 'a|b' lists accepted forms, the first one is authoritative. 'reason' is mandatory.

haber/presente.reason: haber is missing from Jehle and has no model verb; entered by hand. 'hay' is the impersonal form of the 3rd person singular.

haber/indefinido.reason: haber is missing from Jehle and has no model verb; entered by hand (matches verbecc).

haber/imperfecto.reason: haber is missing from Jehle and has no model verb; entered by hand (matches verbecc).

haber/futuro.reason: haber is missing from Jehle and has no model verb; entered by hand (matches verbecc).

haber/condicional.reason: haber is missing from Jehle and has no model verb; entered by hand (matches verbecc).

haber/subjuntivo.reason: haber is missing from Jehle and has no model verb; entered by hand (matches verbecc).

haber/subjuntivo_imperfecto.reason: haber is missing from Jehle and has no model verb; entered by hand (matches verbecc). The -se forms are added by the build.

haber/imperativo.reason: haber is missing from Jehle and has no model verb; entered by hand. Tú imperative is 'he' (RAE), verbecc writes 'hé' with an accent a monosyllable does not take.

haber/gerundio.reason: haber is missing from Jehle and has no model verb; entered by hand (matches verbecc).

valer/imperativo/tú.reason: verbecc gives the archaic 'val'; current usage (RAE) is 'vale', as in Jehle.

obtener/imperativo/tú.reason: verbecc drops the written accent ('obten'); compounds of tener take one: obtén (Jehle).

contener/imperativo/tú.reason: verbecc drops the written accent ('conten'); compounds of tener take one: contén (Jehle).

huir/indefinido/yo.reason: RAE 2010 spelling: 'hui' is a monosyllable and takes no accent; the older 'huí' (given by both verbecc and Jehle) is still accepted.

huir/presente/vosotros.reason: RAE 2010 spelling: 'huis' is a monosyllable and takes no accent; the older 'huís' (given by both verbecc and Jehle) is still accepted.

reír/indefinido/él.reason: RAE 2010 spelling: 'rio' is a monosyllable and takes no accent (Jehle); the older 'rió' (verbecc) is still accepted.

reír/subjuntivo/vosotros.reason: RAE 2010 spelling: 'riais' is a monosyllable and takes no accent; the older 'riáis' (given by both verbecc and Jehle) is still accepted.
